will.witnessPresenceRule: Testator signs at the end in the presence of two witnesses, who each sign in the presence of the testator and of each other.

property.homesteadNotes: Constitutional homestead protection and devise restrictions (Fla. Const. Art. X, sec. 4); spouse/minor children restrict how the homestead may pass.
property.electiveShare: Spousal elective share of 30% of the elective estate (F.S. 732.2065).

prRestrictions: A nonresident may serve as personal representative only if related to the decedent (F.S. 733.304).

poa.superpowersRule: Enumerated 'superpowers' must be separately signed or initialed (F.S. 709.2202).
poa.statute: F.S. Ch. 709 (Florida Power of Attorney Act); execution F.S. 709.2105

trust.agentAmendmentRule: An agent under a durable POA may amend/revoke a trust only if expressly authorized (F.S. 736.0602(5) + F.S. 709.2202).
